{{Quote|Every year at the Arts Gala we hold an art contest to award an Imperial arts grant. They don't do that for that sad little "jubilee" they hold in Restuss! The judges are kept at an undisclosed location -- not even I know where. I need someone to bring these holos of the finalists and their work to an Imperial courier, who will then take it to the judges. Interested?|Jaleela Bindoo to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Dane Windholm''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Courier/Legends|courier]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Jaleela Bindoo]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering a list of finalists to Windholm.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Dane Windholm]]
Dane Windholm was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
